recordings from the same speaker, with often unnatural tone and cadence. WaveNet, on the

speech one sample at the time, with 16,000 samples generated per second. In addition to more
natural sounding voices, only a few minutes of real-life recordings are required to mimic one
particular voice. The same generative approach can be used for other forms of audio, like music.

a generative system producing entire songs from text prompts (Agostinelli et al. 2023).
